title: Hunts FH-014S: The scan route and landing, wired to the claim command

source.ref: Split from FH-014 (2026-11-10): the resolution core shipped in lib/hunts/placement.ts; the route and landing need screens.

detail: Add the scan route and landing that load the placement row, call resolvePlacement, hand a signed-in player a claim token and post to hunt_claim_apply through applyClaim, behind HUNTS_ENABLED and HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED. Done when: a crawler, a wrong-origin URL, a revoked placement and a cross-run token all fail to claim through the real route. Requires: FH-014, FH-010, FH-013. Owner role: Web and QR.
